fed.label: Fed state
fed.description: Your body is digesting and using the energy from your last meal. Blood sugar rises, then settles.

early.label: Early fast
early.description: Digestion winds down. Your body increasingly draws on stored glycogen for energy.

fatburn.label: Fat burning
fatburn.description: Glycogen stores run lower and the body uses more stored fat for fuel. Many people notice fewer hunger waves after this point.

ketosis.label: Ketosis may begin
ketosis.description: Ketone production tends to rise as fasting continues. Timing varies a lot between people and depends on your last meal and activity.

deep.label: Deep fast
deep.description: Longer fasts are studied for cellular recycling (autophagy), but human evidence is still limited. Listen to your body and stop if you feel unwell.

disclaimer: General information only, not medical advice. Individual responses vary. Consult a healthcare professional before fasting if you have a medical condition, take medication, are pregnant, breastfeeding, under 18, or have a history of disordered eating.
